name: @bricx/keycloak-realm
description: Proves the bricx Keycloak realm (P5-01, ADR 0060): policy tests on infrastructure/keycloak/realm-bricx.json, and integration tests that import it into the dev stack's optimized Keycloak image (built from infrastructure/docker/keycloak/Dockerfile, started as compose.yml starts it) and read every setting back.
